verses.gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਾ: ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਬਿਬੇਕ ਆਪਾ ਆਪ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ਹੁਇ ॥
verses.translit_en: soraThaa: pooran braham bibek aapaa aap pragaas hui ||

en.bdb: Sorath: Being supreme conscious and knowledgeable; it seems God Himself has descended as light divine in the form of Guru Hargobind.

verses.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਦੋਇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਏਕ ਗੁਰ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਬਖਾਨੀਐ ॥
verses.translit_en: naam dhoi prabh ek gur gobi(n)dh bakhaaneeaai ||

en.bdb: One may hold them (Guru Hargobind) and Gobind different due to their names, but in reality, God Himself has appeared in the form of Hargobind.

verses.gurmukhi: ਦੋਹਰਾ: ਆਪਾ ਆਪ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ਹੋਇ ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਬਿਬੇਕ ॥
verses.translit_en: dhoharaa: aapaa aap pragaas hoi pooran braham bibek ||

en.bdb: Dohra: Guru Hargobind the enlightened is manifest of Lord. He is granter of spiritual knowledge.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਬਖਾਨੀਐ ਨਾਮ ਦੋਇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਏਕ ॥
verses.translit_en: gur gobi(n)dh bakhaaneeaai naam dhoi prabh ek ||

en.bdb: Guru and Gobind are just two separate names, but in reality it is Lord Himself who is manifest.

verses.gurmukhi: ਛੰਦ: ਨਾਮ ਦੋਇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਏਕ ਟੇਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਠਹਰਾਈ ॥
verses.translit_en: chha(n)dh: naam dhoi prabh ek Tek gurmukh Thaharaiee ||

en.bdb: Channt: Guru and Gobind though are two different names, in reality He himself is refulgent

verses.gurmukhi: ਆਦਿ ਭਏ ਗੁਰ ਨਾਮ ਦੁਤੀਅ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਬਡਾਈ ॥
verses.translit_en: aadh bhe gur naam dhuteea gobi(n)dh baddaiee ||

en.bdb: Sikhs ever in attendance of Guru has this strong belief that, first He was called Guru Arjan and then he gave this honour of Guruship to Hargobind.

verses.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਹਰਿ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਰਚਨ ਰਚਿ ਥਾਪਿ ਉਥਾਪਨ ॥
verses.translit_en: har gur har gobi(n)dh rachan rach thaap uthaapan ||

en.bdb: God Lord is Guru Arjan Himself and then He Himself became Hargobind.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਬਿਬੇਕ ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਹੁਇ ਆਪਾ ਆਪਨ ॥੭॥
verses.translit_en: pooran braham bibek pragaT hui aapaa aapan ||7||

en.bdb: The Omnipotent Lord who created the cosmos, established it and has singular authority of destroying it; it seems He Himself has taken the form of Hargobind to reveal all knowledge about Himself. (7)
